senses.sense_definition: Containing, consisting of, or implying a promise, especially one that is legally binding.

examples.text: Before receiving the loan, he had to sign a <w>promissory</w> note promising repayment within one year.
The business partners drafted a <w>promissory</w> letter outlining when the funds would be returned.

senses.sense_definition: Stipulating future obligations or actions required of the parties to an insurance policy or other business contract.

examples.text: The contract included a <w>promissory</w> warranty that required the building to maintain adequate fire alarms.
Failure to satisfy this <w>promissory</w> condition may result in the complete cancellation of the insurance policy.
